name: cache-stats
description: Prefix-cache hit rate and context pressure, read from usage.record
doc: opencc spends a lot of code placing a stable prefix so the provider can serve it from cache, but nothing measured whether that worked. This mod counts the four token buckets of every API response into a cache-hit ratio (cacheRead / (cacheRead + cacheCreation + input)), keeps the terminal's own context gauge, and publishes both as the `cache.stats` service. A composer badge shows the ratio live; `opencc mods run cache-stats stats` prints the full breakdown. Observer only — it cannot change what was counted.

commands.name: stats
commands.title: Show cache and context statistics
commands.doc: Prints the day's totals, this session's totals and the live context gauge as JSON.

commands.name: reset
commands.title: Clear today's counters
commands.doc: Zeroes the day ledger. The current session's counters are separate and unaffected.
